data.body:
S3 complete — merged as Gerrit change 1988 (LLM-Review+1 & Verified+1), merged SHA be8a60ba11. AC evidence (codebase-verified):

AC1 (one lazy handler per command via a closed adapter kind; only selected modules imported): every core/bridge route in _registry.ROUTES now carries handler+adapter+init (audit/config/reconcile/etc. keep handler=None — intercept ladder untouched); ADAPTER_KINDS is the closed set {dispatcher,argv,argv_tracker,argv_tracker_root}. Proven by test_cli_registry_dispatch: dispatch_routes_carry_a_closed_adapter_and_init_policy, every_adapter_kind_has_at_least_one_route, the per-adapter typed-fake tests, and dispatching_a_read_imports_no_unrelated_handler_or_optional_stack (subprocess: CLEAN — no bridge/transition/reconciler/pydantic_ai leak).

AC2 (remainder argv preserved; selected S2 factory parses exactly once; no route-level grammar): _execute._invoke passes the remainder unchanged and never parses; test_selected_factory_parses_exactly_once_and_unrelated_stay_unimported (build_show called 1x, build_list never imported) and test_router_delegates_core_dispatch_to_the_executor.

AC3 (registry-derived mount/init matches the pre-cutover census incl. no-auto-mount + conditional): init policy per route pinned by test_route_init_policy_matches_pre_cutover_census (27 routes) + the none/init_only/full spies + the doctor and fsck_recover conditional selectors + the export/import split; _store_mount_eligible + _NO_AUTO_MOUNT unchanged; test_central_mount_gate_ad9f green (incl. no_store_command_is_not_force_mounted, help/unknown do not mount).

AC4 (confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON, --, streams, exit codes, exceptions): the _dispatch_confirmable overlay (global --output/--quiet extraction, legacy --output re-injection, confirmation_context) is retained verbatim; test_confirmable_verb_preserves_tokens_after_double_dash, test_malformed_global_output_flag_on_confirmable_verb_exits_two, test_legacy_output_verbs_reinject_the_extracted_format, test_handler_exception_propagates_out_of_execute; test_cli_argparse / test_cli_space_form_options / test_leaf_writes_parity green.

AC5 (bridge compat + hidden bridge-status via approved adapters; purge-bridge unknown): bridge-status routes via the argv adapter with argv_prefix=("status",); test_bridge_status_prefixes_status_through_the_bridge_adapter, test_bridge_canonical_passes_the_remainder_verbatim, test_purge_bridge_remains_unknown; test_bridge_vocabulary_heldout + test_bridge_status_heldout green.

AC6 (switch back to derived compatibility exports without handler/help/data changes): the literal policy frozensets and _DERIVED_POLICY_SETS remain the compatibility exports; derive_policy_sets() reproduces the live router with zero delta (test_cli_registry) and test_derived_policy_sets_still_reproduce_the_live_frozensets. No event/ticket/bridge/help/persisted-data change.

Registry validate() gained execution-metadata checks (unknown_adapter/unknown_init/handler_without_adapter/prefix_without_argv), each with an adversarial detection-path test (teeth verified). Full held-out oracle 60/60 green; mutation of the dispatcher name-prefix and the doctor selector both went RED. make lint/typecheck/complexity-baseline clean; module sizes __init__=535, _registry=707, _execute=82 (<800 cap).
